name: Update Business Problems Doc
description: Manually triggered after a major feature is completed. Updates docs/business/BUSINESS_PROBLEMS.md by mapping the completed feature to business value.

then.prompt: A major AgentMesh feature was just completed. Update docs/business/BUSINESS_PROBLEMS.md with a new entry for this feature. Use the standard 8-section entry format defined in that file: (1) Problem, (2) Current Manual Process, (3) Why That Fails, (4) AgentMesh Solution, (5) Business Impact, (6) Example Scenario, (7) Metrics to Track, (8) Interview / Client Pitch. If the feature is purely technical infrastructure with no direct business mapping, add an explicit note explaining why. Keep the language clear, business-facing, and suitable for a client meeting or recruiter conversation.
